changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-word-mail-workflow-helper.

- Provides guidance for building and troubleshooting Microsoft Word mail merge and DOCX template workflows.
- Outlines steps for assembling documents from templates with various data sources and merge strategies.
- Lists best practices for formatting preservation, repeated sections, and edge case handling.
- Offers fix patterns for common mail merge/template automation issues.
- Includes outputs: template/data mapping, safe generation workflow, validation checklist, and notes on field updates.
